title: Grade 10 MUSIC AND DANCE — General Assessment #2

pages.quiz:
MUSIC AND DANCE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #2
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: MUSIC AND DANCE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Brown, pink, and gold
   B. Black, white, and grey
   C. Green, orange, and purple
   D. Red, blue, and yellow

2. Best practice when working on Dance Production: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Dance Production.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Dance Production.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Dance Production.
   D. Practise Dance Production with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

3. Best practice when working on Music Notation Software: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Music Notation Software.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Music Notation Software.
   C. Practise Music Notation Software with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Damage equipment used for Music Notation Software.

4. Best practice when working on Melody in Major Keys: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Melody in Major Keys.
   B. Practise Melody in Major Keys with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Melody in Major Keys.
   D. Damage equipment used for Melody in Major Keys.

5. Best practice when working on Two-Part Harmony Two-part harmony guidelines;: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Two-Part Harmony Two-part harmony guidelines; with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for Two-Part Harmony Two-part harmony guidelines;.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Two-Part Harmony Two-part harmony guidelines;.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Two-Part Harmony Two-part harmony guidelines;.

6. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Guarantee a trophy
   B. Remove the need for rules
   C. Replace drinking water
   D. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk

7. Best practice when working on Kenyan Folk Songs: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Kenyan Folk Songs.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Kenyan Folk Songs.
   C. Practise Kenyan Folk Songs with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Kenyan Folk Songs.

8. Best practice when working on Rhythm: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Rhythm with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Rhythm.
   C. Damage equipment used for Rhythm.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm.

9. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. Only the volume
   B. The speed of the music
   C. The ticket price
   D. Only the costume

10. Best practice when working on Setting Text to Music: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Setting Text to Music with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for Setting Text to Music.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Setting Text to Music.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Setting Text to Music.

11. Best practice when working on Western Style Solo Songs: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Western Style Solo Songs.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Western Style Solo Songs.
   C. Practise Western Style Solo Songs with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Western Style Solo Songs.

12. Best practice when working on Kenyan Indigenous Musical Instruments 2.4 Western Musical Instruments 2.5 Contem: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Kenyan Indigenous Musical Instruments 2.4 Western Musical Instruments 2.5 Contem.
   B. Practise Kenyan Indigenous Musical Instruments 2.4 Western Musical Instruments 2.5 Contem with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Kenyan Indigenous Musical Instruments 2.4 Western Musical Instruments 2.5 Contem.
   D. Damage equipment used for Kenyan Indigenous Musical Instruments 2.4 Western Musical Instruments 2.5 Contem.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Melody in Major Keys and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Transposition and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Setting Text to Music and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Two-Part Harmony Two-part harmony guidelines; and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. D — Red, blue, and yellow

2. D — Practise Dance Production with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

3. C — Practise Music Notation Software with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

4. B — Practise Melody in Major Keys with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

5. A — Practise Two-Part Harmony Two-part harmony guidelines; with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

6. D — Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk

7. C — Practise Kenyan Folk Songs with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

8. A — Practise Rhythm with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

9. B — The speed of the music

10. A — Practise Setting Text to Music with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

11. C — Practise Western Style Solo Songs with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

12. B — Practise Kenyan Indigenous Musical Instruments 2.4 Western Musical Instruments 2.5 Contem with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Melody in Major Keys; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Transposition; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Setting Text to Music; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Two-Part Harmony Two-part harmony guidelines;; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
